comparison.protocol: 3 alternating AB/BA pairs per corpus; one frozen compiler artifact; equal-length a/b runtime/compiler/cache/output paths; flat caches disabled; each FS cold has isolated empty cache, followed by warm in a fresh process; idle machine; monotonic timing; actual prototype runtime loaded at original filename; output and heap must agree within each paired temperature

implementation.maximum_handling: try geometric capacity; retry exact deficit if rejected; retain failure if exact request fails

trajectory_sensitivity.path_length_matters: Original and minimal comparisons have different harness path lengths. Each comparison has equal-length a/b paths and identical paired heap/output. Do not mix baseline numbers across protocols.
